subject.title: [Bug]: OpenClaw Gateway incorrectly reports false "Codex subscription usage limit" while Codex CLI works with the same ChatGPT OAuth account

question: Does the July 18, 2026 reopen mean the merged structural classifier fix failed to resolve this reporter’s Gateway/app-server path, or is a current-version verification still pending?
rationale: The linked PR claims to fix the central classifier defect, but the same person who merged it reopened and assigned the issue afterward; source and live-path inspection could not be completed in this sandbox.

options.title: Run targeted current-version repro
options.body: Reproduce the same OAuth/CODEX_HOME Gateway path on a build containing the merge and close only when its error metadata no longer produces the false subscription-limit message.

options.title: Split a remaining defect
options.body: If the structured classifier is correct but Gateway still differs from `codex exec`, open or link a narrower issue for the remaining app-server/auth-home mismatch and retain this report as its evidence.

recommendation.title: Run targeted current-version repro
recommendation.body: Reproduce the same OAuth/CODEX_HOME Gateway path on a build containing the merge and close only when its error metadata no longer produces the false subscription-limit message.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged the linked fix and then reopened and assigned this report, making them the clearest available owner for the remaining triage decision.
